title: Total Fourier weight by levels
statement: For every function $f$ from the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to $\\mathbb R$, the sum of its Fourier weights over levels $0$ through $n$ equals the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients over all subsets of $\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
